verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe registering webhook URLs via dashboard, real-time event notifications (e.g. appointment.completed, notarization completion), and HMAC-SHA256 signature verification for securing webhook payloads. This covers subscription, event types, and security, giving solid coverage of an event-driven/webhook subscription model. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that webhooks fire reliably in production and a full enumerated list of all subscribable event types.
